correctness.rationale: Since uv is a unit and y=s/(uv), s and y have identical valuation. In the unit stratum, for each s every y fixes t=s/y and v=s−u, with (2u−s)^2=s²−4t. A root has a unit companion because the product is a unit. As y varies, the discriminants exclude exactly the class s² mod p. Each of the (p−3)/2 remaining nonzero square classes has p lifts with two roots each as a congruence, giving p(p−3)/2 targets of multiplicity two per unit s. Among zero-class discriminants only the exact zero mod p² has roots, exactly p. In the valuation-one stratum, writing s=pα,y=pβ gives −βū²=α; for a fixed nonzero α precisely half the nonzero β admit two roots, and each root has p allowed lifts. Thus (p−1)²/2 targets have multiplicity 2p. The zero pair has all |U| choices u with v=−u; remaining cells vanish. These are distinct positive levels for p≥5. Counting support and taking its complement gives the sumset and zero row; summing squares gives 3p²(p−1)(2p−3). Expanding the fourth power of the unnormalized sums and applying orthogonality over the entire R² gives the factor 1/p⁴, not an average over unit frequencies. The quotient 6−3/(p−1) uses only constant coefficients. `python3 /workspace/branches/frozen_review_checks.py` independently checked every target at p=5,7,11,17,23 and the full-frequency moment at p=5,7 via exact reduction modulo the cyclotomic polynomial. This supplements the all-prime proof, without formal or external certification.
